name: FormFlow
description: Bilingual, role-aware forms and accountable submission workflows for institutions.

paragraphs: Bilingual, institution-owned forms with accountable submission workflows.

FormFlow is a bilingual, role-aware platform that turns institution-owned forms into accountable work. An institution defines what it needs to collect, publishes the form, assigns responsibility for each submission, and keeps requesters and staff aligned through one traceable record.

Operational requests often begin in chat threads, spreadsheets, or fixed-purpose forms. Context gets separated from ownership, status, and follow-up. FormFlow keeps those parts together without deciding what an institution’s process must be.
features: Build reusable English and Bengali forms with sections, validation, and required fields.
Publish immutable form versions so historical submissions stay understandable.
Route submissions through configurable, versioned workflows.
Give each person only the records and actions their institution role allows.
Assign work, record progress, notify responsible people, and preserve an audit trail.

whatItDoes.text: Bilingual, institution-owned forms with accountable submission workflows.

requirements.text: Google sign-in proves who a person is; platform authority and institution membership determine what that person can see and do.
A Resend account and verified sending domain if invitation email is required
